articles.summary: Southland Holdings, Inc. (NYSE American: SLND and SLND WS) (“Southland”), a leading provider of specialized infrastructure construction services, announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 results on Thursday, November 12th, 2026, after market close. Southland will also host a conference call at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Friday, November 13th, 2026. The call may be accessed here , or at www.southlandholdings.com .
